mechanism_narrative: A positive 3-month change in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tightening monetary policy, which increases the discount rate for equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is positive, or the rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 240.0 indicates persistent inflation, which leads to increased risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 240.0, or the rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0% and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening labor market and declining housing demand, which together indicate a deteriorating economic outlook and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0 AND HOUST < 1200.0, or the rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 240.0), the S&P 500 tends to underperform, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5 AND CPIAUCSL > 240.0, or the rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) reading below 1200.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1200.0, or the rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (the 2017 base) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0, or the rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE reading above 5.0% indicates a weak labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or the rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive 3-month change in the demand for consumer goods (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where the 3-month change in RSAFS is positive, or the rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
